recs.name: Break Free
recs.tag: When you can no longer stand your life as it is, smash it apart and choose a new one.

lines.x: Don't move. Hide fast. They're here.
Head inside. In. Right, don't make a peep!
Alright, alright, sir, don't break your bones knocking.
Thanks for keeping us safe. Is everything okay?
Orders from Lord Barth! Searching for a suspect!
(Bro, Filon, what's the deal? What's the 'sir' for...)
(Gotta put up the act in front of other people, right, Sir Raz?)
Searching for a suspect?! Absolutely, search by all means!
But I can tell you there's no suspects in here, sir! We're all good people, I want you to see that!
(Pffheehee.)
(The cupboard makes a rocking sound.)
What was that noise?
Is there anyone else in your house?
N—No. Do you see anyone else? I don't...
Maybe you heard wrong, sir?
Did I? But...
Fine. Look at the size of this place. We'd know if someone was here.
And I didn't hear anything. You're on edge.
Alright... if you say so.
Sirs, are you here for...
This has nothing to do with you. We're done here.
Remember to immediately report any tips to the search team!
Yeah, I will, I will.
Yeesh, are they finally gone?
Hey, stay in there!
Keep it down, they're still close...
It's cool, it's cool, Filon, bro. C'mon, unclench those cheeks.
Raz must've heard me a moment ago, didn't he? I mean, he held it in, and he's not gonna turn back to bust me now.
Relax, relax.
I mean, he probably wants to let you go, but the guys behind him might be a different story.
You're the only woman I've ever met who'd straight-up bomb some old noble's vault, not to mention the part where you drove out throwing the guy's treasure all over the place...
Seriously, Catapult, can you guess how much you're worth right now?
Haha, I bet it can't be as much as all that treasure I left you~
Heh, you got me there.
Honestly, though, where do you get the guts to do this stuff?
That was all his best stuff in that safe, y'know! Hah, he's lost his mind. If he catches you for real, he'll be mad enough to peel you like a yucca!
Fly in, go boom, fly out. I've gotta do this nickname you all give me a little justice, right?
You can only take so much before your back breaks, you know? I'm at my limit with that old-ass... It's not about guts. I was practically forced to do that.
I'm good now, see. I'm refreshed, and everyone gets a little something nice out of it. Peace and love for all, right?
Forced, my ass. Some people wouldn't hit back if their lives depended on it.
*sigh*. I'm gonna be honest, Arleta.
Whoa, why so formal? Just gonna wave my real name like that, huh.
I'm being real with you. I still think... there's nothing in this for you.
Like, what does it get you? 'cause your gold, jewelry, bills... you haven't held onto a single thing, you threw it all over town.
What's your plan?
What's in for me? Heh, c'mon... does everything I do need some kinda paycheck?
...*sigh*. That's not what I mean.

I just—look. You're the old geezer's private army, and he has your share of the pot to give. The tax levy doesn't even come round to you, and if you wanted, you could top up by skimming off all the dues.
When have I ever pocketed your money?
You haven't! If you did, you wouldn't be the first, and I would've shoved you out there.
That's what I'm getting at, at any rate. You live an alright life. You're a far cry from all of us, when we've got days we pay the tax and can't eat afterwards...
What are you actually thinking, Arleta?
If I just said I was done with that old fart, no other ideas going on, would you believe me?
No.
Didn't think so.
Okay then, I need a minute. Lemme come up with some reason for you, ha.
Hey... I'm trying to be as straight as possible here. I don't know, can't you be a little serious?
Bleeugh—you know me, Filon. It's the way I am.
Fine. No more jokes.
I should be outta here soon, anyway. No good sticking around yours forever. Can't let this spiral out, or they'll make hell for you too.
If I jump now, maybe I can rustle my way into a merchant caravan heading out of town.
Did you plan this out beforehand?
Yeah, I don't actually wanna get flayed by the old guy either.
See you later, then...
Pass it on to all the people, if anyone else decides to squeeze their lives out, another explosion as coincidental as that vault might just be on the table.
Never, ever, ever sit there and wait for death like that again.
(This van's a cramped fit... I can't stretch my legs straight.)
(What's this thing even carrying? It's got a smell, alright... good thing I don't get carsick.)
(Ups to my luck, though. Two checkpoints down easy.)
(Good thing I already scoped how the caravan likes to go. It's the perfect ride to hitch.)
(As long as this holds, we just need to cross that bridge, and I should be on my way outta this dump.)
(Once I'm clear, then next, I'll head to... to...)
(Where? Shoot, I have no idea.)
(*yawn* I'm a little sleepy...)
...over there... ...nothing...
...still haven't found them?
(Huh? Why is the search team out here?!)
(He really doesn't wanna give up the chase, huh? C'mon, guy, you're being way too clingy!)
(Let's take a look...)
Sirs, what—what are you looking for?
We're searching for a suspect. Cooperate with us, please.
Raz, we've checked over there! We found nothing suspicious!
Alright, you can pass now.
Ugh, finally, on our way.
Phew, I'm wiped. Do we have to keep on searching each one like this?
That's the old man's orders.
But how much longer do we have to search? We've been going door to door without a break since morning, and now we have to head out all this way.
If it wasn't for the bounty, I would've given up a while ago.
Weren't you clapping and cheering when you heard someone blew the man's vault out?
Of course I was!
It was his private hoard, and now it's in the hands of all the poor common folk! I mean, mwah, who wouldn't give a story like that a thumbs up? Too perfect even for a Columbian movie!
So you...
That's that, this is this. None of the money made it into my hands.
Besides, who'd be on hard times with that reward? The miser's being generous for once!
(Haha! Looks like I really do have a good price tag.)
(No chance of getting over now, seeing how this all panned out. Even if I hide in a box, they could find me sooner or later...)
(Gotta do it. Times like these, your only choice is—)
(Hup!)
Ergh! My ass!
Oof, I'm not hurt... no, wait, where's my wallet? Did someone just steal my wallet?!
Thief... there's a thief! Catch the thief!
Quit the racket! What happened?
Knight, sir...! Th—Th—There's a thief!
(And one more for the road...!)
(Check me out!)
Waagh! Wh—What the hell?
Yeek! Sir Knight, some bastard just felt me... Hey, you were right there! Was it you?!
Eh? I didn't do it... hey, what are you hitting me for?! Seriously, it wasn't me!
Settle down, please, settle down!
All of you, calm down... don't get hysterical!
Where's my wallet?!
Back up, everyone! Our search here isn't over yet... ugh!
Who threw that stone?!
I can't take it anymore! Tell me, how much longer am I going to be stuck here?
I've gotten official passage! I request to be let through here immediately!
Hold on, this is by Lord Barth's command—
He's just a cruddy knight noble with a hunk of land. Who does he think he is?
(Hahaha!)
(Mm-hm, and there's my moment.)
Phew...
Finally, out of there.
Apologies, Mister, I'll toss your wallet in your van. And you over there, Miss, truly very sorry, I'll let you sock me sometime...
But sorry's all I can give right now!
See ya, everybody~
You're better off apologizing to their faces than doing it out here to the trees.
Stir chaos, hide in the crowd and slip out of the mess. You almost fooled me.
Oh, hey, it's you.
Still got caught, huh? That's not good.
I would've gotten away with it too, if it weren't for your sharp eyes, Raz.
Speaking of, when'd you put all this gear on? You look pretty slick, really like a capital-K Knight. May as well enroll for knighthood sometime, right?
The old fart's always been wanting to raise up a Knightclub.
This road... should take me to my destination, if I'm not mistaken.
Hm?
Oh? What's that up there...?
Nothing else to say?
Have a care, huh? I'm gonna look real long-winded if it's just me talking, y'know~
What, you're not here to cuff me and take me back? If you don't do anything, I'm gonna get away, alright? I'm warning you.
If I was going to bring you in, I would've busted you back at Filon's.
If I actually did that... chances are Lord Barth would give you a public hanging for real.
True that, hahaha. Old guy's gotta be blowing his top!
So why'd you chase me out here anyway? Did you wanna give me a ride?
Yes...
...Whuh?
Raz. Raz, bro.
Any way you slice it, the old guy's got all hands out for me. I'm wanted by name... You're deserting, here!
And you get to talk?
Who slinked off to hit up the streets and go drinking, back when we were on patrol together—
Stoppit, stoppit, let's not reopen old wounds. Bad.
I came to ask you, why—
Why let go of the good days, and risk it all on this?
...Yeah.
Man, it's not healthy to be stale like this~ Why's everyone ask this one question?
And if I confess it was just 'cause I was sick of the old guy, you don't even believe me!
I believe you.
Guh?
It's a majorly convincing reason, knowing you.
Are you commending me, or dunking on me... Filon sure didn't believe me one bit.
Whatever. We're way past that, now. Let me be real with you.
Under the geezer, as long as we do what we're told, we get everything taken care of, and we get a little allowance. And sure, maybe a whole lot consider those fine days to live.
But I just couldn't stand it anymore. Everything that happens everywhere pisses you off. That life grosses me out, down to the core.
But I can't say that in front of the people in that town. I can't drop those words.
I've never gone hungry. How do I have the right to tell people without a meal to eat that I think my life sucks?
So you did it for all the civvies who couldn't pay taxes...
Yeuch, don't make me out like some kind of beacon of righteousness. I'm not THAT good-hearted.
I wasn't counting on doing something for anyone else's sakes. Blowing that geezer's vault open, dumping everything in there everywhere, that was all just me channeling my revenge.
Simple as that~
Oh, my...
She's a surprisingly clear-minded girl.
But still, not quite that cautious...
Raz—!
What are you doing here?
Oh, crap, they're coming this way! Hide somewhere, quick!
Easy for you to say... there's nowhere to hide here, is there?!
Raz? What are you doing... are you talking to somebody?
I—
(Crap, I can't make it!)
Excuse me, sorry for that. I was occupying this kind gentleman's time.
(—Who?)
(She walked out from behind... was she seriously behind me the whole time?!)
Hm? Who is it?
You're... wait, it can't be, i—it's you?!
Pardon me. Please, don't be so nervous. I'm just a traveler passing through.
I was asking this gentleman the way just now.
Huh... is that right?
Uh... yeah, that's right.
Um, forgive me, but are you... by any chance, the Candle Knight?
Ah. That is indeed my title.
The Candle Knight?! THE renowned Knight from Leithanien... I've seen a whole bunch of your matches!
I never expected to meet someone as famous as you here! C... Could you, um, sign—sign this for me, Miss Knight?
I appreciate your praise. If just my signature suffices, I would be delighted.
(This lady's totally distracting everyone!)
(Just who...)
(Shh.)
(Is she winking at me...?!)
This doesn't seem too well a place for conversation. If you don't mind, shall we talk as we go?
I've been wanting to pay a visit to the good Lord of this place, as it turns out... so could I trouble you all to show me the way?
Of course... of course!
(She led them off for real... Did she—save me?)
(Catapult.)
(What?)
(To be honest, I didn't have any other real reason to come find you.)
(I just wanted to tell you this, personally... I don't have your courage, but I admire you.)
(This little town's too little. Maybe this whole place confines you, in a way.)
(Seize the moment. Go on.)
Ahh...
What a nightmare. Here I was banking on having all my bills settled, and I could start my new life free as the wind.
If I think about it, I've racked up new favors along the way now.
Nyeaah...
Oh, well~ I've got a few decent bros in my old haunt I can think back on, and that's not a bad feeling~
And that Candle Knight lady. What a serious weirdo... but she helped me out big time, so consider my 100% fan loyalty as my payment!
I guess this really is goodbye... everyone.
See you again...
Phew...
Alright, time to really think about it now. Where should I be off to next, I wonder~
Hm...
Well, let's leave Kazimierz for starters, and go see what the world beyond is like!

recs.name: Change
recs.tag: How much can time really change?

lines.x: Kazimierz Outskirts
Catapult's Hometown
This is the place, right?
Right, this is it.
I scattered gold coins all over this street, you know?
Come on, enough of that. This street looks no different than all the other ones.
I'm telling the truth.
The truth? You?
Hahahaha.
Oh, come on. I'm being serious.
For real?
For real.
Alright, alright, I'll believe you, just this once.
When are you heading back to Rhodes Island?
Tonight.
You sure that's enough time?
I'm just here to take a look around. Half a day's plenty of time.
Mm-hm.
It's 7 A.M. right now.
I'll be waiting for you around... 7 P.M. here tonight.
Sounds good.
I'll bring you lots of souvenirs.
You better make sure you don't get caught first.
Keep your terminal on you and keep the channel clear. If anything comes up, let me know right away.
Oh, stop treating me like a kid. Off you go.
And here I'm trying to be nice. Fine.
I'm not giving you a ride back if I don't see any souvenirs.
No problem, I'll make sure you get to try the dates!
Phew...
Alright, let's see how this hellhole's changed.
The edge of town looks pretty much the same, but the town center...
Oh, looks like they spent a lot of money here.
I bet that old fart wouldn't have spent even half a coin on this place.
Looks like the li'l knight who's running the joint might just be a decent fella.
The young master's alright. We've been living a much more comfortable life than before.
Hey, long time no see. Looks like you've been holding up pretty well the last couple years, Filon.
You got that letter, and you still came back, huh?
Look at you. You look like you're doing pretty well yourself, Arleta.
What's the deal? You never called me by my real name before.
Did you forget my nickname? Or are you looking down on me? Hm?
Yeah, yeah, yeah.
Catapult.
Happy?
Now that's more like it.
You haven't changed a whole lot since the last time I saw you.
What have you been up to out there?
After I got out, I found myself a gruntwork gig. It pays pretty well, though, and I get to travel everywhere.
What about you? How's everything been after that whole thing?
*Sigh*...
You wouldn't know, but not long after you left, the old bastard had the whole town searched. He didn't manage to get even a fourth of his treasures back, though.
He was so pissed that he jacked up the tax rate.
Oh, uhh...
So, what about now? That's still going on?
Nope. It lasted maybe two or three months.
I'm not entirely sure what happened after that, but an investigation team from the big city paid us a visit.
I don't really know what they talked about, but we never saw the old fart again. Word is he retired and went back home to rest.
Then the young master came. First, he changed the tax rate back. Then he spent a huge amount of money on the town. That's why the place looks the way it does now.
Mm-hmm, sounds like he's got a bright future as a leader.
Right, you've been away for so long, I bet you hardly recognize the town. Let me show you around.
C'mon.
Hey, ehhh, wait!
What's wrong?
I'm still wanted. I probably shouldn't just walk on in there.
Come on, didn't I tell you in the letter? The young master canceled all the arrest warrants that had to do with the incident.
For real?
What, you don't trust your old buddy Filon?
Of course I do! How could I not?
Now hurry and lead the way! I can tell from here the whole town's a maze now. I can't imagine making my way around alone.
Right, how long are you staying?
My company's landship happens to be sailing through the area, so I took a little time off. I'll be gone by the end of the day.
Well, look at you. Keeping yourself busy even on vacation.
Come on, I actually came back to check the place out after I read your letter. Sheesh.
Now hurry. Show me around.
Alright, alright. Let's go.
Here, does this place look familiar? This is the factory I used to work at. It's been fully renovated.
They even have air conditioning now. It's much more comfortable inside now.
Hm...
Filon, I got a question.
Sup?
They used to grow food in that patch of land all the way out of town, didn't they?
That's right.
How come it's all grapes now?
It's not just that one spot. The young master's planning to turn all the farmland here into a huge vineyard.
We have good soil here, and we can grow some top quality grapes. They make pretty good money.
But what about food?
You don't eat grapes for all three meals, right?
Hah, of course not.
With the grapes, we have the money to buy food from other places.
It's all imported?
That's right.
You really got to hand it to those big shots from the cities. Thanks to them, our markets are lined with stuff that we never got to eat back in the day.
Oh yeah? Sounds nice.
(Sounds like the young master's much more reliable than the old fart.)
(But if they don't grow any food here, what will they do if the big shots in the cities raise their prices?)
There used to be factories all around town. The young master's planning to merge their operations, and once the big factory's open, we'll all be raking in big bucks with him.
(Oh well, sounds like I'd be raining on his parade. I'll just keep it to myself.)
Speaking of, how about I show you the factory?
Sure. The last time I was here, they didn't even have a single brick laid yet.
Wow, it's huge. I bet not even the old man's mansion back home is this big.
Damn right.
And it isn't even done yet. We're working on one side of the factory, while the other side's still being built.
Once the factory's completed, I reckon the whole town will work here.
The whole town...? No way.
'If you want work, then it's work you'll get.'
That's what the young master said.
You remember the old man who used to feed us radishes?
The bald grandpa?
Yep.
He had a huge family, so he didn't have to work the fields himself. He had lots of free time.
Now, the young master gave him a job as a security guard.
He's got something to do, and he can help out with his family's expenses. You should've seen how happy he was.
That sounds pretty nice.
(But... looking around... this doesn't seem like a place you could work with an easy mind...)
Has the young master thought about cleaning up the area around the factory, though?
On our way here, the entire place smelled like acid.
He told us to bear with it, and that he'll take care of it once the factory's done.
He's the old jerk's son, though. Do you really believe every word he says?
Well, we've all had it pretty nice the last couple years, thanks to him.
Yeah, looks like you've had it better than anyone.
Haha, that's right. Much better than before.
Maybe he'll put you up for sale, and you'll even help him count his money.
Heh, I wouldn't go that far.
Then why don't you tell me what you actually got from that young master of yours?
Well, it's a long story. Why don't we find a restaurant somewhere and we'll talk there?
A restaurant? We've got fancy stuff like that here?
Yeah, and it's cheap, filling, and delicious.
Sounds like a plan. Lead the way. I'm starting to get hungry.
*Burp*.
How's that? Tastes great, doesn't it?
Uhh, yeah.
(Here I thought it was going to be some five star restaurant.)
(This is just a fast food restaurant and a pub!)
(But this is much better than the scraps the old man used to give us. We sometimes had to skip meals, too.)
(I guess fast food... is kind of a luxury in a way.)
(The servings are big, it's filling, and it doesn't cost that much.)
(But everything outside... has changed so much.)
That young master isn't trying to tear down the entire town, right?
Oh, yeah, that's pretty much what he's done.
Take a guess. What do you think this fast food joint used to be?
Hmmm...
The fountain square?
Nope.
The square is still there, at least, right?
It's gone.
Damn, that's my only landmark.
Let's see...
The courthouse?
Getting warmer.
That's still not it?
Hm...
You don't mean—
(Imitates an explosion)
That?
Bingo.
Well, the young master is really trying to erase all traces of the old man.
He even rebuilt this place.
So where's the young master? Where does he live?
Right there. On the top.
You'll know what I mean once you step outside and take a look. There isn't another building here that tall.
All the rich and famous people in town live there.
I thought you raked in a lot of money. How come you didn't move in?
Heh, I still have a ways to go compared to those who really made it big.
I have a bit of savings, much thanks to you.
And I hid it pretty well when the old bastard was still running things.
But as soon as the young master came along, I thought I'd use the money to start a business.
Nice. You've always had pretty good luck ever since we were kids, and you're smart. You probably raked in tons of money, didn't you?
Ehh? Nope... It's not that easy...
The young master had a huge area plotted out when he started working on his factory, so I figured I would open a small shop right next to it.
But as soon as I signed my lease, he decided to start building his factory from the other end.
Since I'd paid up already, I had no choice but to open the shop.
Only the few families in the neighborhood come visit.
I've been in the red all these years, even now.
And I have no idea when they'll start building the factory on my side either...
But you've been tooting his horn all day long.
You don't get it.
We've had knight competitions here ever since that knightess lass paid the old man a visit.
But it only got this popular thanks to the young master.
Now, not only do we get some decent games to watch...
(Whisper) We get to earn some cash too.
You watch the games... and you make money from that? That sounds too good to be true.
I'm not kidding.
(Checks wristwatch)
Perfect. This afternoon's games are about to begin.
I'll pay for your ticket. Come on.
Alright.
(Sounds good up front.)
(But how come it feels like something's not quite right?)
Should be this row.
(Sits down)
This is a sofa?! Whoa, it's so comfy!
This young master really spares no expense huh.
This indoor arena's even bigger than that tower he lives in.
It's our town's landmark, at least until the factory's all built.
It's big, it's got style, and it's comfortable.
We get to enjoy all this, so of course we've got a few nice things to say about him.
Heh, sounds right.
Hm?
How come there's a terminal on the seat?
Oh, that?
Listen up, Catapult. This is how I make money.
What do you mean?
Welcome one, welcome all to the arena! I am your commentator for today's game.
First off, let us welcome the rising star of our town, the independent knight Raz!
Raz?!
Didn't he used to be a cop for the old fart?
What's going on here?!
A lot of people lost their jobs that day, thanks to you. Raz's one of them.
At first, he said he was going back home to work the fields, but ever since he met that high-class knightess, suddenly all he'd say is 'I'm going to become a professional knight' and stuff.
I thought it was just talk.
But he was serious.
And he was one of the first to sign up when they started running competitions here.
The guy always had decent looks, and he's not half bad too. He's pretty popular all over town.
And of course, the most important thing is that...
He wins.
I'm not so sure about today's match, though...
And his opponent—former Glorious Shield equipment tester and independent knight—Mr. Stone!
Equipment tester...?
Hey, hey. This guy's definitely no pushover!
Yeah, I know. Calm down.
Your terminals are now active.
Care for a little wager? Or maybe buy some chips to drop in supplies to help them out?
The fate of the knights lies in their hands—and yours!
The terminal's on...
(Taps the terminal for a while)
What are you doing?
Quiet. Give me a minute.
The odds are stacked against Raz... but...
The payout, though...
Alright, I'm betting on Raz!
(Taps the terminal for a while)
You bet... 5000?
That's... not a currency, right?
It is. It's just a number right now, but whatever you punch in during the competitions, you'll have to pay if you owe anything after the match.
There's bound to be people who can't pay it back, right?
If you can't pay... you make it up to the young master by working for him.
Do you know what you're doing?!
I'm betting on Raz!
As long as he wins, I'll be swimming in cash! Get it?!
I did my research. Raz's numbers don't look good, but he will win.
I'm sure he'll win!
But what if he loses?!
Right, I sometimes slip up.
But as long as I bet on Raz, he's going to win!
Just trust him, and trust me, okay?!
Let the games begin!
(Ignores Catapult and stares intently at the competition.)
(Filon...)
(Raz can't match that Stone in skills or equipment. Don't you know that?)
(He may be talented, but that's a country guard fighting a veteran mercenary!)
(I know you're lucky, but this...)
That's it, Raz! Good one!
(He's giving it all he's got right up front. If Dobermann was here training him, he'd be getting the whip.)
I'm telling you, Raz's going to win.
(Enters 1000 on the terminal's keypad)
That's what I'm talking about, Raz! Beat the living hell out of him!
(How long will he last?)
15 minutes later...
What's wrong, Raz? You can take that hick!
H-Hang in there! I'll send you some supplies!
(Taps the terminal for a while)
(His opponent is starting to fight back...)
(Hold on?!)
That outsider hick's not holding back at all!
I-It's a no-limits match...
Ugh.
My money... M-My money...
(Switches on the comms)
(Whispers) Hey, can you hear me?
Loud and clear. What's the matter?
Are you getting arrested?
(Whispers) Something like that. Get ready, and drive to the arena in the town center.
(Whispers) Think you'll be able to get us out alive?
Understood, and worry about yourself first.
Keep the channel open.
(Whispers) Thanks.
(Reloads ammo)
(Pressurizes weapon)
Raz! Raz, you can't lose!
I don't care if you die, but what about my money?!
Out of the way!
(It won't be easy to land this hit without collateral damage from this distance...)
(Aims)
(Argh, whatever! I'm going for it!)
(Raz, you're a good guy. You shouldn't die here.)
(After this, we'll be even, and there'll be nothing left for me here.)
(Alright, you big dummy, come closer!)
(Pulls the trigger)
(Concentrates)
What a beautiful shot!!!!
Just as victory was within reach, Mr. Stone suddenly turned toward the audience.
And our little fella took his chance!
He raised his sword and struck his opponent down in one hit!
A textbook comeback!
Victory goes to the independent knight—Raz!
What?
H-He won?!
He won! He won!! I won!!
What did I tell you, huh, Catapult?
Whenever I put money on Raz, he wins! Every time!
Hahahahahaha!!!!
(Lowers weapon)
Catapult. Catapult?
Hey.
I'm here. Look to your right.
Coming.
Looks like shit didn't hit the fan.
Guess nothing good came of your visit, then.
